confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Santiago price levels, projected to July 2026 using assumed Chilean inflation and an unverified remembered CLP/USD rate near 940. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable; cocktail and wine are set partly from the local ratio to draft beer (about 1.6x and 1.1x). Hostel and hotel anchors are least certain. No live listings or booking pages were checked. The FX value was taken from search excerpts of the RBA page, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable listing was used. The basis is Santiago's remembered price levels, projected forward and placed among higher-cost Latin American capitals, above Lima and Bogota and below Western European capitals.
